verdict.rationale: RudderStack has dedicated Consent Management and Compliance Toolkit features explicitly claiming to capture consent and sync preferences downstream to every destination, plus PII masking/blocking capabilities, which directly address the story. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing/docs with no independent verification, technical detail on per-destination consent enforcement logic, or hands-on confirmation that opt-outs are honored automatically by all 200+ destinations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of downstream enforcement, technical documentation of consent category mapping per destination, and confirmation of opt-out propagation mechanics.
